title: Document Compare 1.21.19
notes:
The requested follow-on groups were implemented in order. Abbreviation/time checks add six exact Celsius, Fahrenheit, Rankine, kelvin, Baumé and Twaddell full-name/symbol definitions, complete whole-hour/o’clock forms, and original-source safeguards for bare measurements and clock signs. Symbol checks add the printed “The result is” numeric multiplication form and complete dollar-symbol series in applicable Digest/Opinion/Cover letter contexts, with LCB priority. Contextual wording checks add three printed repeated-prefix forms, four sake expressions and five printed holiday names in finite source roles.

GPO 11.16 now offers conditional Review Suggested findings for selected complete web/email addresses whose entire physical source span has coherent known font-run evidence and at least one italic run. Evidence is limited to the 12 standard Latin Times, Helvetica and Courier faces. Unknown/OCR/invalid fonts, gaps, overlaps, quotes, source-created names, tables and removed text cannot establish a finding. Original physical PDF offsets are checked after word-division restoration. The finding has no replacement: preserve italics required for legislative additions, amendment markup and faithful quotation until their purpose is confirmed in the original PDF.

Validation: all 2,816 source tests and 17 controlled packaged desktop stages passed. Production replay across 23 unchanged bill models / 2,024 pages yields 857 → 857 findings, with 0 additions, 0 removals and 0 changed retained findings excluding regenerated IDs. All differences reviewed; all 34 original PDFs retain their hashes. Existing cached corpus models lack the new font provenance; a separate real PDF verifies font extraction, worker review and physical selections. Office precision/recall is unmeasured.

Coverage remains partial. Broad algebra, ambiguous or signed/fractional/scientific measurement meanings, military/noon/midnight interpretation, unfamiliar wording, complex address syntax, visual font appearance, insertion-markup purpose and general page layout remain manual. The 29 supplied California Codes name/shorthand rows and all 58 California Counties remain independent checks. Code section numbers and jurisdiction/identity are not validated. AB 2266 OCR uncertainty and missing AB 109/SB 879 drafting materials remain review items. Office precision/recall is unmeasured.

Extract the ZIP and keep the entire "Document Compare" folder together, then open Document Compare.exe. Offline engines, reference manuals and their licenses/notices are included. LCB priority and the separate California Codes/Counties references remain active.
